enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +12: Passive: +12 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Ice Lore +12: Passive: Your Cold spells gain a 12% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Void Lore +12: Passive: Your Negative Energy and Poison spells gain a 12% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Glaciation +84: Passive: +84 Equipment bonus to Cold Spell Power.
Nullification +84: Passive: +84 Equipment bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power.
Insightful Glaciation +42: Passive: +42 Insight bonus to Cold Spell Power.
Insightful Nullification +42: Passive: +42 Insight bonus to Negative (Necrotic) and Poison Spell Power.
Evocation Focus +4: +4 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Necromancy Focus +4: +4 Equipment bonus to the DC of Necromancy spells.
Magical Efficiency 5%: You take a 5% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of your spells.
